contributions.detail: 11 typed rows sum to 4,850.00. One of them (Jess Bradfield 50.00) is not an over-$50 contribution: it is the cover's line-2 aggregate, which the filer chose to itemize. Carr form prints no schedule total, so the cover is the only anchor (§A of the cache addendum). The cover's own identity closes: 5,271.00 + (-471.00) = 4,800.00. Cents on lines 1-2 are written as superscripts over the rule and are transcribed with a decimal point per core §3(g).

Expense side: 4,409.05 - 4,121.94 (interim cum) = 287.11 = exactly the three expenditure rows this summary adds (Will Ward 75.00 + Ethan Ward 75.00 + Maymoe's 137.11).
